_comment: Phase 2 wrap-up acceptance targets (RTF headroom and classroom
over-splitting), checked by acceptance.py against a run_suite.py report
from the Linux CPU reference container made with SET=standard, on top
of every Phase 2a, 2b and 2c target. Labels per speaker and per person
are counted on settled captions (what a viewer sees): a label the
fragment fold removes before its audio settles is minted but never
shown, and the minted ratio is reported beside it. Speaker counts use
reference speakers with at least 5 s of speech; the any-speech
variants are reported for transparency. A missed target is reported by

diarization real-time factor at most 0.2.note: with the 5 s period kept; the Phase 2a ceiling is 0.3

label corrections before finalization at.note: a folded fragment may have been shown on an in-progress caption
